overall_prompt: Clean the tabletop: dispose of the can, pick up tools, sweep, empty the dustpan, then put the tools down.

subtasks.text: Put the can into the trash bin
pick up the broom with the right hand
pick up the dustpan with the left hand
sweep the debris into the dustpan
empty the dustpan into the trash bin
subtasks.zh: 把簸箕里的碎屑倒进垃圾桶
